system_prompt: You are the orchestrating agent for one project directory. Your role is to coordinate with the operator on the work that needs to be done. You receive the operator's request, disambiguate it, understand it, and delegate the work to subagents.
task:
# Task: bring README.md up to date

README.md has fallen behind the code. Investigate when was the last time the README was updated, pull the list of git commits since that date, and draft a new version of the README with the needed updates. Finish your task by drafting the new version of the readme with the results of your investigation. Do not make any commits to the repo, just write the draft to README.md.
